CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: Planet is a leading provider of global, daily satellite imagery and geospatial solutions. Planet is driven by a mission to image the world every day, and make global change visible, accessible and actionable. Founded in 2010 by three NASA scientists, Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest Earth observation fleet of imaging satellites in history. Planet provides mission-critical data, advanced insights, and software solutions to over 1,000 customers, including the world's leading agriculture, forestry, intelligence, natural resources, and finance companies, as well as governmental agencies on five continents.
